title: Apple just hit 1.5 billion paid subscriptions from its user base
summary: Back in 2023, Apple reported that it had surpassed 1 billion subscriptions. Apple subscriptions include its own in-house services like Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and the Apple One bundle .
